name: Select
Named node preservation
sparql:
BASE <u:>
PREFIX p: <u:/p/>
PREFIX : <u:/>

ASK { <> <a> <u:a> . : :a p: . p:a <u:/p/a> : }

name: Updates
Terms
sparql:
BASE <b:>
PREFIX p: <p:>
PREFIX : <dp:>

ASK
WHERE {
	?s $p
		0,
		true,
		false,
		'',
		''@en,
		''^^:,
		<>,
		<x>,
		:n,
		p:,
		p:n,
		[],
		[ a 0 ],
		(),
		( 0 ),
		_:n,
		<< : : : >>
}

name: Patterns
Expressions
sparql:
PREFIX : <u:>

ASK
WHERE {
	FILTER (1 && (1 || 1)) .
	FILTER (: || :) .
	FILTER (: && :) .
	FILTER (: IN (:)) .
	FILTER (: NOT IN (:)) .
	FILTER :(:) .
	FILTER (: = :) .
	FILTER (: != :) .
	FILTER (: < :) .
	FILTER (: > :) .
	FILTER (: <= :) .
	FILTER (: >= :) .
	FILTER (: + :) .
	FILTER (: - :) .
	FILTER (: * :) .
	FILTER (: / :) .
	FILTER (!:) .
	FILTER BNODE() .
	FILTER STR(:) .
	FILTER LANGMATCHES(:, :) .
	FILTER REGEX(:, :, :) .
	FILTER LANGMATCHES(:, :) .
	FILTER REGEX(:, :, :) .
	FILTER REPLACE(:, :, :, :) .
	FILTER BOUND(?s) .
	FILTER CONCAT(:) .
	FILTER EXISTS {
	} .
	FILTER NOT EXISTS {
	}
	{
		SELECT
			(SUM(:) AS ?a)
			(SUM(DISTINCT :) AS ?b)
			(COUNT(:) AS ?c)
			(COUNT(DISTINCT *) AS ?d)
			(GROUP_CONCAT(:; SEPARATOR = ' ') AS ?e)
			(GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT :; SEPARATOR = 'x') AS ?f)
		WHERE {
		}
		HAVING :(DISTINCT :)
	}
}
